caption: The drawing depicts three views of a suit in muted tones on a textured gray background. Dominating the composition is a full front view of a light-colored suit with a high-waisted, double-breasted jacket featuring wide lapels and a deep V-shaped neckline. The jacket has long sleeves, and the suit's trousers are narrow and fitted, extending straight down with minimal creasing, and ending in cuffs. To the right, there are two smaller representations: one is the back view of the jacket only, and the other is the full back view of the suit, both mirroring the same pale, almost white color with faint gray shadows emphasizing the construction lines, seams, and contours. The drawing’s details are outlined in a slightly darker hue, and the whole image is set within a beige border. There is a small signature in the lower left corner.
title: Coat and Trousers
